verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents its own bulk capabilities: the API is pitched for 'large bulk adjustments' to accounts and domains, smart folders allow folder-wide domain changes, bulk search adds all available names to the cart in one click, and bulk transfer moves domains 'all at once'. The evidence stays at the marketing level, and the MCP tool list covers only single-item actions, so an AI-native bulk workflow is implied rather than fully documented. missing for 10: documented batch/multi-item API endpoints with semantics such as limits, partial-failure handling and async job status, bulk actions exposed through the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: If you're looking to make large bulk adjustments to your account or domains, our API makes the process quick, efficient, and accurate.
Setup new domain smart folders and make folder-wide domain name adjustments to help you stay organized.
Add all available searched domains to your cart with one click.
Transfer your domains from another provider to Dynadot all at once.
